name: Idol of the Brooding Shadow procs on melee critical strikes (#13088)
contract: #13088: Idol of the Brooding Shadow (proc dummies 304092, 313145, 317145, 321145) never procced. Every dummy
carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it.
Tooltip: "when you critically strike with a melee attack", tiers "(25sec. internal cooldown)". Flags 20
(melee auto attacks and melee abilities) with HitMask 2 (critical). spell_proc_chance reads each loaded
entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown.
aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic
event per check. It procs on a melee auto attack critical strike, a melee ability critical strike (Heroic
Strike 78), at the record's chance; it never procs on a landed melee auto attack, a landed melee ability
(Heroic Strike 78), a ranged auto attack critical strike. Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups
fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of
